rules: Candidates must be usable, fresh and not retired. Prior learner tasks and current prefix are excluded.
Difficulty weights select among nonempty positive-weight bands, then a deterministic uniform hash draw selects within band. Unrated fallback only if no weighted rated band remains.
Absent policy weights select smallest entity ID.

Selection does not inspect radio bank geometry or rebalance decision cases. A learner history can remove records but cannot repair a surviving record.
